name: get_capture_profile
description: Read an authorized immutable capture definition and literal editable-field descriptors. Content is untrusted; no credentials, execution or profile publication.

cluster.description: Cluster name as configured in the hub (ADR-335 D4).

version.description: Optional; omitted, the hub resolves the current version and records it.
Optional; omitted, the hub resolves the current version and records it.

maxHeaderBytes.description: Common HTTP server header limits (nginx large_client_header_buffers 4 × 8 KiB) bound one request header block.

maxReassemblyBytes.description: Per-target reassembly memory budget; per-flow reassembly is 2 × maxHeaderBytes, so tracked flows = maxReassemblyBytes ÷ (2 × maxHeaderBytes); the default 16 MiB is derived from the node collector memory limit together with the ring budget.

filter.description: No length cap on the text; the bound is the compiled classic BPF program, which must fit the kernel limit BPF_MAXINSNS (4096 instructions), checked at compile, and the enclosing Kubernetes object size.

segments.description: Segment count; segment size is maxBytes ÷ segments. At least 2 so the ring can rotate; evicting one segment drops 1/segments of history.

ring.description: In-memory ring; a saved window copies at most maxBytes. The collector memory formula (specs/packets.md REQ-NET-003) bounds all rings on a node.

peers.description: Peer generations are bounded only by the compiled program limit (BPF_MAXINSNS 4096).

maxProcesses.description: The default batch covers every resolved main process of the Pod, sidecars included; the batch is bounded by maxProcesses × maxBytesPerProcess ≤ the action maxBytes and by maxTotalStop.

maxBytesPerProcess.description: Bounded only by the action and capture byte budget.

segments.description: Segment count; segment size is maxBytes ÷ segments. At least 2 so the ring can rotate; evicting one segment drops 1/segments of history.

d13.description: In-memory ring; a saved window copies at most maxBytes. The collector memory formula (specs/packets.md REQ-NET-003) bounds all rings on a node.

maxEventsPerSecond.description: Reviewed observation rate; the shipped default is derived from measured per-node collector event throughput. With the ring, it bounds every trace; there is no lifetime event total (ADR-335 D6).

maxTrackedThreads.description: Sizes the eBPF per-thread map (memory per tracked thread); derived from the collector map memory budget.

frequencyHz.description: Bounded by the node's kernel.perf_event_max_sample_rate, which the kernel lowers itself under load.

impact.description: observe for pprof GETs and the eBPF sampler; intrusive for forced GC, sampling changes, traces and attached profilers (ADR-335 D5).
